subject_group: 6.1.10 Vertical/short takeoff and landing air vehicles

versions.text: Criterion: Verify that V/STOL hovering translation is safe. Standard: The air vehicle meets the standards within MIL-STD-1797, 5.2.7.1.9 Hovering translation. Method of Compliance: Verification methods include analysis, test, demonstration, simulation, and inspection of process, design, test, or configuration documentation.

Standard: The air vehicle is no worse than Level 2 flying qualities during hovering translation. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis of all hover translations to evaluate air vehicle capabilities and control margins, to include: a. Baseline control system. b. Precision hover modes. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess flying/handling qualities as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Hovering Translation paragraph and Translational Rate Command (TRC) in Hover paragraph for each combination of air vehicle states, control modes, and environmental conditions, to include: a. Baseline control system. b. Precision hover modes. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess flying/handling qualities as specified in MIL-STD- 1797, Hovering Translation paragraph and Translational Rate Command (TRC) in Hover paragraph for selected combinations of air vehicle states, control modes, and environmental conditions, to include: a. Baseline control system. b. Precision hover modes.
